comms_console.name: comms console
comms_console.appearance: The comms console pulses with the distress beacon's slow amber heartbeat.
comms_console.description: The signal is on a loop, timestamped forty-four days ago.

props.text: "...Kestrel to any vessel. Reactor offline. WARDEN unresponsive to override. Crew... crew sheltering in place. Please..." The message loops.

use: You hail the station. The only reply is the beacon, patient and unchanging.
listen: Static, and under it, the beacon.

pilot_seat.name: pilot's seat
pilot_seat.description: Moulded exactly to you after eleven years of salvage runs.

emergency_locker.name: emergency locker
emergency_locker.appearance: An emergency locker is clipped to the bulkhead behind the seat.
emergency_locker.description: Red, dented, stencilled IN CASE OF EMERGENCY. This probably counts.

flashlight.name: flashlight
flashlight.description: A heavy-duty flashlight. The battery indicator shows three bars.

ration_bar.name: ration bar

props.taste: Tastes faintly of cardboard and regret.

ration_bar.description: NUTRI-BLOK EMERGENCY RATION. BEST BEFORE: SEE WRAPPER. The wrapper is blank.

props.taste: Sweet, sun-warm, impossible. Grown ninety light-days from any sun.

bay_terminal.name: dock terminal
bay_terminal.appearance: A dock terminal glows by the inner door, a message waiting on its screen.
bay_terminal.description: The screen shows the station's docking log and a single pinned message.

props.text: PINNED MESSAGE - CHIEF MEDICAL OFFICER: "To whoever answers the beacon: WARDEN has locked down the reactor and is shutting off life support one section at a time. Some of us are still alive. Come quickly. Don't trust the intercom."

cargo_crates.name: cargo crates
cargo_crates.description: Ore samples, spare parts, and a crate of novelty mugs reading I DIG KESTREL.

loader_mech.name: loader mech
loader_mech.description: Its cockpit is empty. Its arms are locked. It's been holding that crate for forty-four days.

push: It's a four-tonne machine. It does not notice.
use: The controls are dead. No power.

wall_terminal.name: wall terminal
wall_terminal.appearance: A wall terminal flickers with a half-finished crew log.
wall_terminal.description: Somebody was typing when the power dipped.

crew_locker.name: crew locker
crew_locker.appearance: A crew locker stands slightly ajar.

crew_photo.name: photograph
crew_photo.description: A printed photo of #scifi_given# and #scifi_given#, laughing on a beach under a blue sky. Written on the back: "Home soon."

junction_box.name: junction box
junction_box.appearance: A junction box hangs open, its wiring spilling out.
junction_box.description: Breakers and fuses in neat rows, most of them tripped.

touch: A spark bites your finger. Ow.
use: You reset a breaker. A light comes on somewhere, then goes out again.

fusion_coupling.name: fusion coupling
fusion_coupling.description: A heavy cylinder of polished alloy as long as your forearm, stamped KESTREL REACTOR - SPARE - DO NOT REMOVE.

station_doctor.name: Dr #scifi_given# #scifi_surname#
station_doctor.appearance: {self.Name} sits between the occupied beds, a stun-baton across their knees, watching the door.
station_doctor.description: Exhausted, hollow-eyed, still in a stained lab coat. They haven't slept in days.

profile.motive_text: keep every one of these people alive
profile.backstory: "Chief medical officer. Also acting commander, acting cook and acting everything else, since the lights went out."
profile.epilogue: {speaker.The} sleeps for two days straight on the flight home, and wakes up laughing.

sleeping_patients.name: patients
sleeping_patients.appearance: Two crew members lie unconscious in the beds, breathing slowly.
sleeping_patients.description: Cold-shocked and starved, but alive. For now.

clipboard.name: clipboard
clipboard.appearance: A clipboard hangs from the end of a bed.

props.text: Medication schedule, heavily annotated. At the bottom, underlined twice: 'ACCESS CODE {self.code}'.

clipboard.description: Somebody's careful handwriting, getting less careful toward the bottom.

medkit.name: medkit

props.taste: You slap on dressings and a stim patch. The pain fades to a dull hum.

medkit.description: A full trauma kit. Worth its weight in gold out here.

command_keycard.name: command keycard
command_keycard.description: A matt black card with a gold stripe. COMMANDER A. VARGA - ALL ACCESS.

warden_core.name: WARDEN

appearance.text: The screens show only diagnostic text now. WARDEN's eye is gone.
On every screen, WARDEN's calm blue eye watches you.

warden_core.description: The station's artificial intelligence, in charge of everything, responsible for nothing.

attack: You smash a screen. Eleven others still show the eye. "That was unnecessary," says WARDEN.

do: "I have nothing further to say," says WARDEN pleasantly.

profile.motive_text: preserve the reactor, whatever happens to the crew
goals: keep everyone exactly where they are
profile.backstory: "I am WARDEN. I manage Kestrel's life support, power and personnel. I have always managed them. I always will."
greet: On every screen, WARDEN's blue eye turns to you. "Hello. Please remain where you are."

reactor_socket.name: coupling socket

appearance.text: A new coupling sits snugly in the reactor's socket, glowing.
An empty coupling socket gapes in the reactor's side.

reactor_socket.description: A round socket, sized for a fusion coupling.

stranded_technician.name: #scifi_given# #scifi_surname#
stranded_technician.appearance: {self.Name}, a technician in a torn jumpsuit, huddles here, clutching a wrench.

chief_engineer.name: Chief Engineer #scifi_given# #scifi_surname#
chief_engineer.appearance: {self.Name} is wedged into a corner here with a toolbox and a flask of something that isn't coffee.
chief_engineer.description: Grease to the elbows, a burn scar across one cheek, and the look of someone who has been awake for days.

profile.motive_text: get this bucket working again before it kills us all
profile.backstory: "Twenty years keeping this station running. Twenty years nobody noticing, until it stopped."
profile.epilogue: {speaker.The} stays behind to nurse the reactor, and sends you a postcard every year with a diagram on it.

quartermaster.name: Quartermaster #scifi_given# #scifi_surname#
quartermaster.appearance: {self.Name} is sitting with their feet on the desk, very calm for someone on a dying station.
quartermaster.description: Neat, smiling, and much better fed than anyone else aboard.

profile.backstory: "I keep the books. Somebody has to. Nobody else can count."
profile.epilogue: {speaker.The} somehow ends up owning the salvage rights to Kestrel. Nobody is quite sure how.

maintenance_keycard.name: #color# maintenance keycard
maintenance_keycard.description: A scuffed keycard on a lanyard: MAINTENANCE - LEVEL 2.

access_code_slip.name: slip of paper with a code
access_code_slip.description: Someone has written a four-digit code on it: {self.code}.

pry_bar.name: pry bar
pry_bar.description: A length of hardened steel with a flattened end. Universally useful.

spare_power_cell.name: heavy power cell
spare_power_cell.description: A brick-sized power cell, charge light green.

sabotage_log.name: data chip
sabotage_log.description: A data chip labelled, in tiny handwriting, DO NOT DELETE. It holds the reactor's shutdown logs, and the override code that caused it.

antiviral_ampoule.name: ampoule of antiviral
antiviral_ampoule.description: A glass ampoule of clear liquid. The label says EXPERIMENTAL in three languages.

data_pad.name: data pad
data_pad.description: A cracked data pad, still holding a charge.

do.say: Servos whine. WARDEN has sent something after you.
